verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's docs show that `tofu plan -out=FILE` saves a plan to disk, which you can later run by passing the file to `tofu apply`. That is the saved-plan-artifact half of the story, and plan files can also be encrypted at rest. The evidence never mentions non-interactive or approval flags, nor any CI-specific guidance, so only about half the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documented approval flags (e.g. auto-approve), non-interactive/no-input mode, CI automation guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of CI plan/apply workflows.
